title: Refund request spike (noisy / incomplete)
research_question: What most likely explains the spike in refund requests last week?
analyst_instructions: Read the evidence packet only. Do not discuss it with the other analyst. Separate temporal coincidence from support, and preserve unresolved uncertainty rather than forcing a single explanation.
reviewer_instructions: Complete the prose-only baseline before opening Reviewer Matching. Pay particular attention to whether the report treats noise or an unsupported coincidence as a meaningful divergence.

evidence.text: The primary shipping carrier reported regional delivery delays starting Monday.
Refund requests citing 'item never arrived' rose 3x starting Wednesday.
Overall order volume was flat week over week.
A billing-page redesign shipped on Tuesday of the same week.
